ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) built using Qiskit to optimize chip layout wire routing, reducing wirelength intersections significantly compared to greedy classical heuristics.
ideas.title: VQE-Router: Quantum-Accelerated VLSI Routing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies Qiskit to a famously intractable real-world NP-hard problem in hardware design, matching the event's core focus on real-world problem solving.

ideas.pitch: A financial portfolio risk assessment tool using Qiskit's Quantum Amplitude Estimation (QAE) algorithm to achieve quadratic speedup in estimating Value at Risk (VaR) over classical Monte Carlo simulations.
ideas.title: Q-Portfolio: Quantum Amplitude Estimation for Risk Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages genuine quantum algorithmic advantages for high-value financial computations, which instantly appeals to judges looking for true quantum utility rather than gimmicks.

ideas.pitch: A Qiskit-powered application that computes the ground state energy of small drug-like molecules using the Unitary Coupled-Cluster ansatz and VQE, targeting early-stage pharmaceutical lead validation.
ideas.title: Quantum Molecular Ground State Solver for Drug Discovery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a domain where quantum computing is predicted to achieve early commercial supremacy, making the abstract and demo video immediately compelling to scientific judges.

ideas.pitch: A smart grid energy distribution optimizer implementing the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) via Qiskit to minimize power transmission losses across microgrid nodes.
ideas.title: QAOA Smart Grid Load Balancer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical infrastructure problem using combinatorial optimization, demonstrating clear real-world applicability as mandated by the event guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A Qiskit implementation of adiabatic quantum simulation principles to dynamically route urban traffic signals and alleviate congestion bottlenecks during peak rush hours.
ideas.title: Q-Traffic: Quantum Annealing-Inspired Traffic Flow Flow Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a universally relatable urban pain point with a sophisticated quantum circuit simulation, ensuring a high-impact demo video and abstract.
